description: Manages operations for a Gmail add-on, including creating and updating interactions, finding related records, and creating new records directly from emails.

endpoints.name: CreateInteraction
endpoints.description: Creates a new interaction record within the system, typically initiated from the Gmail add-on context.

model.description: The request body containing details for the new interaction.

example_uses: Create a new interaction for an email conversation.
Log a new customer interaction from Gmail.
Record a follow-up activity related to an email.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use when you need to log a new interaction or activity originating from a Gmail email or thread.

endpoints.name: UpdateInteraction
endpoints.description: Updates an existing interaction record in the system, often to reflect changes or new information from Gmail.

model.description: The request body containing updated details for the interaction.

example_uses: Update the status of an existing interaction.
Modify details of a previously logged email interaction.
Add notes to an ongoing interaction from Gmail.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use when you need to modify or add information to an interaction record that has already been created.

endpoints.name: FindGmailInteraction
endpoints.description: Searches for and retrieves specific interaction records based on criteria provided from the Gmail add-on.

model.description: The request body containing criteria to find Gmail interactions.

example_uses: Find an interaction linked to a specific Gmail message ID.
Retrieve interactions associated with a particular email address.
Search for interactions based on Gmail context.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use to locate and retrieve existing interaction records that are relevant to the current Gmail context, such as an open email.

endpoints.name: FindRelatedRecords
endpoints.description: Identifies and retrieves records from the system that are related to the current Gmail context, such as contacts, organizations, or projects.

input.description: The request body containing information to find related records based on Gmail context.

example_uses: Find all contacts related to the sender of the current email.
Retrieve projects associated with the email's domain.
Discover existing records that might be relevant to the email conversation.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use when you need to find existing records (e.g., contacts, accounts, opportunities) in the system that are linked to or relevant to the current email or its participants.

endpoints.name: CreateRecordsFromEmails
endpoints.description: Facilitates the creation of new records (e.g., contacts, leads, tasks) directly from information extracted from one or more emails.

request.description: The request body containing details to create records from email information.

example_uses: Create a new contact from an email signature.
Generate a new lead record based on an incoming email.
Create a task or follow-up item directly from an email.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use when you want to quickly create new structured records in the system by extracting relevant data from one or more selected emails.
